items.has: An upgrade tells you every migration note your project's version selects, by path and headline.
The entry point carries the communication-language and attribution blocks, placed from your answers.
The installed kit holds no file the package stopped shipping.
The project's rules carry the story-sessions section.
The orchestration settings carry the epic and task slots, each resolved to your environment or to solo with the reason.
The kit-owned checker gates are declared.
The rules your project reads state the session-close value section and one task per session.
A new work queue is seeded with the named row.
The Recommendations screen names every difference from this profile you have not declined, with the command for each.
